title: Supply a query default
summary: FastAPI: Supply a query default. Visit /page?n=3.
introduction: An input not in the path is read from the query. GET /page with no n uses its default.
learningObjectives: Supply a query default with FastAPI

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Supply a query default

blocks.text: Because n is absent, the Python default supplies 1. The handler returns that page value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A default makes the query input optional.
